name: Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth

abilities.text: Each land is a Swamp in addition to its other land types.

notes: The layers family declines this wording in the PARSER (docs/vocabulary/layers.md limit 2: CR 305.6, a granted basic land type brings no intrinsic mana ability) but the engine applies the layer for a hand-written script, and it is the doc own example. Known divergence: a land that becomes a Swamp this way does not gain "{T}: Add {B}", so the card is right for Swamp filters, swampwalk and domain and wrong for mana.
